one_line: Work OS where teams build and customize boards, items, and workflows without code.
auth_notes: GraphQL API; admins/members have their own API tokens; guests cannot get tokens and must use OAuth or short-lived tokens. Apps framework for native integrations.
self_serve_notes: Free trial account then paid plans; tokens are self-service in account settings for any admin/member.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Boards, items, column values, groups, subitems, users, workspaces, docs; also REST endpoints and webhooks.

existing_mcp.note: Community monday.com MCP servers exist; official MCP not confirmed.

evidence.note: Fetched 'The basics' page confirms GraphQL API, token access rules, products supported, and apps framework.

agent_notes: Free-trial account needed; guest access requires OAuth flow.
